mapper.select: SELECT alarm_id FROM alarm WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACK')
SELECT TOP 1 close_data_ts FROM alarm WHERE equipment_id = #{equipmentId} AND status = 'CLOSED' ORDER BY created_at DESC, alarm_id DESC

INSERT INTO alarm (equipment_id, batch_id, status, first_detected_ts, last_detected_ts, max_prob, detect_count) OUTPUT INSERTED.alarm_id VALUES (#{equipmentId}, #{batchId}, 'OPEN', #{result.firstDetectedTs}, #{result.lastDetectedTs}, #{result.maxProb}, #{result.detectCount})
mapper.update: UPDATE alarm SET max_prob = CASE WHEN #{result.maxProb} > max_prob THEN #{result.maxProb} ELSE max_prob END, last_detected_ts = CASE WHEN #{result.lastDetectedTs} > last_detected_ts THEN #{result.lastDetectedTs} ELSE last_detected_ts END, detect_count = detect_count + #{result.detectCount} WHERE alarm_id = #{alarmId} AND status IN ('OPEN', 'ACK')
mapper.select: SELECT FROM alarm a JOIN equipment e ON e.equipment_id = a.equipment_id WHERE a.alarm_id = #{alarmId}
